content.text: Single continuous first-person view across this desk at the same military clerk in the supplied first frame. One closed, tied bundle of bamboo slips is already resting at the near edge of the desk. The clerk gently slides that bundle toward himself with one hand, then rests his hand. The bundle remains closed and tied. Camera remains stationary, no other person enters the frame. Soft cloth and wood contact sounds only. No speech, no music, no writing or subtitles.
